body.raw:
{
  "title": "Two Sum",
  "description": "Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. You may assume that each input would have exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice.",
  "inputFormat": "Line 1: integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^4)\nLine 2: n space-separated integers nums[i] (-10^9 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^9)\nLine 3: integer target (-10^9 ≤ target ≤ 10^9)",
  "outputFormat": "Two space-separated integers: index1 and index2 (0-indexed)",
  "constraints": "2 ≤ nums.length ≤ 10^4\n-10^9 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^9\n-10^9 ≤ target ≤ 10^9\nOnly one valid answer exists.",
  "difficulty": "EASY",
  "timeLimit": 1000,
  "memoryLimit": 256,
  "examples": [
    {
      "input": "4\n2 7 11 15\n9",
      "output": "0 1",
      "explanation": "Because nums[0] + nums[1] == 9, we return [0, 1].",
      "ordering": 1
    },
    {
      "input": "3\n3 2 4\n6",
      "output": "1 2",
      "explanation": "Because nums[1] + nums[2] == 6, we return [1, 2].",
      "ordering": 2
    }
  ],
  "testCases": [
    {
      "input": "4\n2 7 11 15\n9",
      "expectedOutput": "0 1",
      "isSample": true,
      "timeLimit": 1000,
      "memoryLimit": 256,
      "ordering": 1
    },
    {
      "input": "3\n3 2 4\n6",
      "expectedOutput": "1 2",
      "isSample": true,
      "timeLimit": 1000,
      "memoryLimit": 256,
      "ordering": 2
    },
    {
      "input": "2\n3 3\n6",
      "expectedOutput": "0 1",
      "isSample": false,
      "timeLimit": 1000,
      "memoryLimit": 256,
      "ordering": 3
    }
  ],
  "tagIds": []
}

{
  "title": "Reverse String",
  "description": "Write a function that reverses a string. The input string is given as an array of characters s.",
  "inputFormat": "Line 1: A string s consisting of printable ASCII characters",
  "outputFormat": "The reversed string",
  "constraints": "1 ≤ s.length ≤ 10^5\ns[i] is a printable ASCII character",
  "difficulty": "EASY",
  "timeLimit": 1000,
  "memoryLimit": 128,
  "examples": [
    {
      "input": "hello",
      "output": "olleh",
      "explanation": "The string 'hello' becomes 'olleh' after reversal.",
      "ordering": 1
    }
  ],
  "testCases": [
    {
      "input": "hello",
      "expectedOutput": "olleh",
      "isSample": true,
      "timeLimit": 1000,
      "memoryLimit": 128,
      "ordering": 1
    }
  ],
  "tagIds": []
}
